source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.7, printed page 105.

blocks.text: Evaporation (bhaap ban kar urna) kisi bhi temperature par liquid ka spontaneously (khud ba khud) vapour mein badalna hai.

Jab zyada energy wale molecules liquid chhor dete hain aur kam energy wale peechhe reh jate hain, to liquid ka temperature gir jata hai. Phir surroundings (aas paas) se heat liquid ki taraf aati hai aur surroundings ka temperature bhi gir jata hai. Is se samajh aata hai ke evaporation thandak paida karti hai.

Nahane ke baad hawa lagne par jism se pani evaporate hota hai aur insan ko thandak mehsoos hoti hai: H₂O ke molecules jism ki energy le kar ur jate hain. Earthenware vessels (mitti ke bartan, jaise matka) bhi isi wajah se pani thanda rakhte hain. Mitti ke bartan mein pores (bareek surakh) hote hain.

Jin pani ke molecules ke paas intermolecular forces torne jitni K.E ho, woh in pores se bahar aa kar evaporate ho jate hain. Yeh process chalta rehta hai aur is ke liye energy liquid se hi aati hai. Is liye baqi pani ke molecules ki average K.E kam hoti hai aur pani ka temperature gir jata hai. Isi liye matke ka pani thanda rehta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhri jumle mein “Hens” chhapa hai; sahi lafz “Hence” (is liye) hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Evaporation mein sab se tez (zyada energy wale) molecules nikal jate hain, is liye peechhe rehne walon ki average energy, yani temperature, kam ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Geele kapre hawa mein jaldi kyun sookhte hain aur pasina (sweat) jism ko thanda kyun karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Hawa naye vapour ko door le jati hai, is liye evaporation tez hoti hai. Pasina evaporate hone ke liye energy jism se leta hai; tez molecules ur jate hain aur jism ke surface ka temperature gir jata hai.

items: Evaporation: kisi bhi temperature par liquid ka khud ba khud vapour banna; tez molecules nikal jate hain, baqi ki average K.E kam, is liye thandak (nahane ke baad jism, matka).
